name: SolidPing
tagline: Uptime monitoring, alerting and status pages, self-hosted
description: SolidPing monitors HTTP(S) endpoints, TCP/UDP ports, DNS records, SSL certificates, ICMP ping, and databases, plus scriptable browser and JavaScript checks for anything those don't cover. Alerts go out over email, Slack, Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp and generic webhooks, with escalation policies and maintenance windows. Public status pages, a multi-region distributed worker system, and multi-user organizations with role-based access are included. Existing Uptime Kuma users can import their monitors directly. Single Go binary, SQLite by default.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: ghcr.io/fclairamb/solidping:0.37.0@sha256:b7905f7747e217c259f7442b14fcdb49b145b06dbe6791f9fc8dd4dde5e95428
    container_name: big-bear-solidping
    restart: unless-stopped
    # The image runs as nonroot (uid 65532) and has no shell. Running as root
    # lets it write to host bind mounts created by the platform as root.
    user: "0:0"
    # Needed for ICMP ping checks.
    cap_add:
      - NET_RAW
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:4000"
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "/app/solidping", "healthcheck"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 15s
